name: Emaar
about: Emaar builds whole districts rather than single towers, so its launches arrive with parks, retail, schools and transport already designed in. Its current pipeline stretches from Dubai Creek Harbour and Dubai Hills Estate to Emaar South beside Al Maktoum airport.

projects.name: Greencrest
projects.blurb: A residential cluster in Dubai Hills Estate that pairs clean architecture with landscaped courtyards and parkland, aimed at households that want a calm daily rhythm close to the city.

projects.name: Grove Ridge
projects.blurb: Low-rise family living inside Emaar South, built around shared greens and walkable streets for neighbours to meet rather than pass.

projects.name: Golf Vale
projects.blurb: A golf-course address in Emaar South where homes are arranged to borrow the fairway landscape, with sports and leisure close by.

projects.name: Creek Haven
projects.blurb: A waterfront launch on the creek in Dubai Creek Harbour, the district Emaar is shaping as a second city centre beside the Ras Al Khor sanctuary.

projects.name: Terra Woods
projects.blurb: Part of Emaar's residential offer around Expo City Dubai, a post-Expo district designed for walking, cycling and shared public space.

projects.name: Avarra by Palace
projects.blurb: A branded residential tower in Business Bay carrying the Palace hospitality name, for buyers who want hotel-grade service in a central location.

projects.name: Rashid Yachts & Marina
projects.blurb: A marina district with a working yacht harbour, where residences sit beside the waterline and the leisure economy of the port.

name: DAMAC
tagline: Branded living, from towers to lagoon villages.
about: DAMAC is known for pairing its homes with fashion, automotive and sporting names, and for large resort-style communities. The portfolio ranges from Business Bay towers to the lagoon-centred districts of DAMAC Lagoons.

projects.name: Chelsea Residences
projects.blurb: A waterfront development created in collaboration with Chelsea Football Club, combining sea and skyline views with sport and wellness amenities.

projects.name: DAMAC Casa
projects.blurb: A residential tower in Al Sufouh, between Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah, for buyers who want the coast and the Marina's dining close at hand.

projects.name: Reva Residences
projects.blurb: A Business Bay tower close to the canal and Downtown, suited to professionals who want the central business district on the doorstep.

projects.name: DAMAC Prive
projects.blurb: A premium Business Bay launch from DAMAC's higher-end collection, with a design language aimed at more discerning city buyers.

projects.name: DAMAC Lagoons
projects.blurb: A master community of Mediterranean-style neighbourhoods arranged around large lagoons, with townhouses and villas themed on European coastal towns.

projects.name: DAMAC Islands
projects.blurb: A tropical island-themed community in Dubailand, with villas and townhouses grouped around water features and landscaped islets.

projects.name: Park Greens
projects.blurb: Suburban villas within DAMAC Hills 2, a community that has grown around parks, a golf course and everyday family amenities.

name: Sobha Realty
tagline: Backward integration, built to be seen up close.
about: Sobha controls much of its own construction chain, from design to finishing, and markets that as the reason its buildings look tightly detailed up close. Its flagship is Sobha Hartland, with the eight-million-square-foot Hartland II rising beside it in Mohammed Bin Rashid City.

projects.name: Sobha SeaHaven
projects.blurb: A seafront high-rise at Dubai Harbour, set to look out across the Gulf with marina and yacht-club neighbours.

projects.name: Sobha Skyscape
projects.blurb: A tower within Sobha Hartland II, designed around open green space and canal edges in a district planned for walking.

projects.name: Sobha Skyvue
projects.blurb: A residential tower in the Hartland II masterplan, which devotes more than a third of its land to open and green areas.

projects.name: 360 Riverside Crescent
projects.blurb: Residences arranged on a crescent beside the Hartland II waterway, built around river-side landscaping and promenades.

projects.name: Waves Opulence
projects.blurb: A waterfront project inside the original Sobha Hartland, where towers face a lagoon and the Burj Khalifa skyline.

projects.name: Sobha One
projects.blurb: A multi-tower complex beside the Ras Al Khor wildlife sanctuary, with the creek on one side and the city on the other.

projects.name: Sobha Sanctuary
projects.blurb: A villa community in Dubailand, planned around green belts and low-density streets for family living away from the towers.

name: Azizi Developments
tagline: High volume, with a new district every year.
about: Azizi has built a reputation on pace, with many projects launched across Dubai and a first step into Sharjah. Its portfolio runs from beachfront Riviera in Meydan to Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Islands.

projects.name: Azizi Venice
projects.blurb: A lagoon-led community in Dubai South, designed with waterways, boulevards and a central water body as its organising idea.

projects.name: Riviera
projects.blurb: A beachfront community with a crystal lagoon at the heart of Meydan, close to Downtown Dubai and everyday amenities.

projects.name: Mina
projects.blurb: A waterfront project on Palm Jumeirah that gives buyers the island address with marina frontage and sea views.

projects.name: Azizi Wasel
projects.blurb: A residential development on Dubai Islands, the new man-made archipelago off the Deira coast with beaches and marinas.

projects.name: Azizi Milan
projects.blurb: A multi-building residential community in Dubai Land, positioned near Global Village and the city's growing south-eastern corridor.

projects.name: Azizi Raffi
projects.blurb: A mid-rise building in Al Furjan, a well-connected suburb with Metro access and an established retail and school ecosystem.

projects.name: Azizi Florence
projects.blurb: Azizi's newest release and its entry into Sharjah, bringing the developer's apartment format to the neighbouring emirate.

name: Imtiaz Developments
tagline: Design-led towers with a point of view.
about: Imtiaz has built a long list of mid-rise residences, now moving into more concept-driven projects, from a wellness-focused tower to a Zaha Hadid Architects-designed building. It works in Dubai Islands, Dubailand, Meydan Horizon and Jumeirah Village Circle.

projects.name: KORE by Imtiaz
projects.blurb: A residence conceived around human performance and longevity, drawing its name from the body's core and built around movement and recovery.

projects.name: The Archive by Imtiaz
projects.blurb: A building organised around reading and quiet, where the common spaces are designed for slow hours rather than loud ones.

projects.name: Raw District II
projects.blurb: The second phase of an urban district off Sheikh Zayed Road, built to be used rather than admired, with spaces that overlap and connect.

projects.name: Sea Cliff by Imtiaz
projects.blurb: An island address on Dubai Islands, laid out between shaded pathways and open-water views.

projects.name: Enre Residence
projects.blurb: A residence in Dubai South planned to let daily life flow with the outdoors, close to the future airport district.

projects.name: The Symphony by Imtiaz
projects.blurb: A building designed by Zaha Hadid Architects in the Meydan Horizon masterplan, treated as a dialogue between form and feeling.

projects.name: Wynwood Horizon
projects.blurb: A distinguished address in the heart of the Meydan Horizon masterplan, positioned for business, culture and leisure access.

name: Danube Properties
tagline: Themed towers with an amenity-first pitch.
about: Danube gives each building a theme, from sport to jewels to bays, and fills it with a long list of shared amenities. It is also known for a monthly instalment structure that many buyers from India and the wider region follow closely.

projects.name: Oceanz
projects.blurb: A waterfront tower group in Dubai Maritime City, themed around the sea and aimed at buyers who want the coast without the Marina price of entry.

projects.name: Sportz
projects.blurb: A 39-floor tower built around active living, with an Olympic-sized lap pool, climbing wall, sky jogging track and coaching as amenities.

projects.name: Elitz
projects.blurb: Twin towers in Jumeirah Village Circle with a tower-wide amenity floor, in a suburb known for parks and everyday convenience.

projects.name: Diamondz
projects.blurb: A tower in Jumeirah Lake Towers, built for professionals who want the lakes, Metro and the Marina within quick reach.

projects.name: Bayz101
projects.blurb: A Business Bay tower with canal-side access, part of Danube's run of Bay-themed buildings aimed at central-Dubai tenants.

projects.name: Jewelz
projects.blurb: A jewel-themed building in Arjan, a quieter pocket between Al Barsha and Dubai Hills with a growing retail base.

projects.name: Eleganz
projects.blurb: Danube's first ready-to-move-in launch, delivering apartments and townhouses in Jumeirah Village Circle.

name: Binghatti
tagline: Architecture first, with partners from the car world.
about: Binghatti is recognised by its sculptural, geometric facades and by collaborations with Jacob & Co, Mercedes-Benz and Bugatti. Its towers cluster in Business Bay, Downtown Dubai, Al Jaddaf and Jumeirah Village Circle.

projects.name: Burj Binghatti Jacob & Co Residences
projects.blurb: A super-tall tower in Business Bay in partnership with the watch and jewellery house Jacob & Co, advancing through its upper levels.

projects.name: Mercedes-Benz Places
projects.blurb: A Mercedes-Benz-branded residential tower rising in Downtown Dubai, with design detailing drawn from the car marque.

projects.name: Bugatti Residences by Binghatti
projects.blurb: A tower that carries the Bugatti name and design cues in Business Bay, aimed at collectors of the brand and of the skyline.

projects.name: Binghatti Hills
projects.blurb: A multi-building project in Dubai Science Park with distinctive geometric facades and access to the Al Barsha corridor.

projects.name: Binghatti Skyrise
projects.blurb: A Business Bay high-rise whose angled facade is a signature of the developer's recent skyline projects.

projects.name: Binghatti Gateway
projects.blurb: A tower in Al Jaddaf beside the Dubai Canal, one stop from Business Bay with creek-side access.

projects.name: Binghatti Mirage
projects.blurb: A mid-rise block in Jumeirah Village Circle, with a reflective facade and the suburb's parks and schools around it.

name: Omniyat
about: Omniyat builds a small number of design-focused towers, often with a hospitality partner such as Dorchester Collection and architects such as Zaha Hadid. Its work sits in Business Bay and on Palm Jumeirah.

projects.name: ORLA, Dorchester Collection, Dubai
projects.blurb: A Dorchester Collection-branded address on the Palm's crescent, with hotel service woven into the residences.

projects.name: ORLA Infinity
projects.blurb: A follow-on branded project on Palm Jumeirah, set around the island's sea-facing frontage and infinity pool lines.

projects.name: One at Palm Jumeirah
projects.blurb: A low-density Dorchester Collection residence on Palm Jumeirah, with private pools and beach-level living.

projects.name: The Lana
projects.blurb: A Dorchester Collection hotel and residences tower in Business Bay, built beside the canal in the city's busiest district.

projects.name: VELA
projects.blurb: A Dorchester Collection residential tower in Business Bay, with the hospitality brand's concierge and design standards.

projects.name: VELA Viento
projects.blurb: A sister tower to VELA, rising nearby with the same hospitality brand and a distinct sail-inspired silhouette.

projects.name: The Opus
projects.blurb: A Zaha Hadid Architects-designed building in Business Bay, known for its cube split by a void, with a hotel and offices inside.

name: Samana Developers
about: Samana builds apartment communities with Mediterranean and island themes, mostly in Dubai Studio City, Jumeirah Village Circle and Arjan. Its buildings lean on lagoon-style pools and lifestyle amenities.

projects.name: Samana Golf Avenue
projects.blurb: A community on the edge of Dubai Studio City organised around a golf outlook and generous landscaped podium.

projects.name: Samana Mykonos
projects.blurb: A Greek-island-inspired development in Dubai Studio City, with whitewashed forms and a lagoon-style pool.

projects.name: Samana Santorini
projects.blurb: A sister island-themed project in Dubai Studio City, with sunset-view terraces and a resort-style podium.

projects.name: Samana Waves
projects.blurb: A wave-themed building in Jumeirah Village Circle with a terraced pool deck and everyday retail close by.

projects.name: Samana Park Views
projects.blurb: A building in Arjan with a park-facing outlook and quick access to Al Barsha and Dubai Hills.

projects.name: Samana Barari Views
projects.blurb: A residential project in Majan, within the Dubailand growth corridor, designed around gardens and communal terraces.

projects.name: Samana Ivy Gardens
projects.blurb: A garden-themed community in Dubailand with planted courtyards and a family-friendly mix of buildings.

name: Dubai Properties
tagline: Established communities, from JBR to Mudon.
about: Dubai Properties is a master developer with long-running communities, including Jumeirah Beach Residence, Business Bay, Dubai Wharf and Mudon. These are mature neighbourhoods with years of resident history.

projects.name: Jumeirah Beach Residence
projects.blurb: One of Dubai's best-known beachfront neighbourhoods, a continuous strip of towers with a pedestrian Walk and direct beach access.

projects.name: Business Bay
projects.blurb: The canal-side business district developed by Dubai Properties, mixing offices, residences and hotels beside Downtown.

projects.name: Dubai Wharf
projects.blurb: A creek-side development in Culture Village, with the waterfront and the old creek skyline as its backdrop.

projects.name: Mudon
projects.blurb: A family villa and townhouse community in Dubailand, built around parks, a community centre and schools.

projects.name: Mudon Views
projects.blurb: A newer Mudon neighbourhood, with fresh landscaping, parks and quick access to the main Dubailand roads.

projects.name: Villanova
projects.blurb: A Mediterranean-style townhouse community in Dubailand, with village squares and tree-lined streets.

projects.name: Remraam
projects.blurb: A large apartment community in Dubailand with central landscaping and on-site community facilities.

name: Empire Developments
tagline: Boutique luxury in small, finished runs.
about: Empire Developments works in a boutique format, with a handful of luxury projects delivered one at a time. Its public portfolio includes Empire Livings, Empire Estates and Empire Residence.

projects.name: Empire Livings
projects.blurb: A luxury residential project that Empire has delivered, positioned as part of its design-focused portfolio.

projects.name: Empire Estates
projects.blurb: A luxury community from Empire, at an advanced stage of construction according to the developer's recent updates.

projects.name: Empire Residence
projects.blurb: Part of Empire's portfolio of boutique residences, with a focus on finish and everyday service.

name: Arada
tagline: Destination developer, from Sharjah to the Palm.
about: Arada started in Sharjah with Aljada and Masaar and now builds in Dubai and Abu Dhabi, including the Armani Beach Residences on the Palm. It treats each community as a destination with its own retail, schools and green space.

projects.name: Aljada
projects.blurb: A large mixed-use destination in Sharjah with apartments, retail, entertainment and a cultural core.

projects.name: Masaar
projects.blurb: A green, villa-led community in Sharjah, planned with forest-like landscaping and walkable streets.

projects.name: Masaar 3
projects.blurb: A later phase in the Masaar community, extending the villa neighbourhoods and green corridors.

projects.name: Nasma Residences
projects.blurb: An apartment community in Sharjah with shared courtyards and a retail strip.

projects.name: Armani Beach Residences
projects.blurb: A beach-front, Armani-branded residential development on Palm Jumeirah, with interiors by Armani/Casa.

projects.name: Anantara Residences Sharjah
projects.blurb: A branded residence tower pairing the Anantara hospitality name with Sharjah's waterfront.

projects.name: Jouri Hills
projects.blurb: A residential community in Dubai from Arada's newer portfolio, planned around landscaped streets.

name: Nakheel
about: Nakheel created Palm Jumeirah and is now building Palm Jebel Ali and Dubai Islands. It also manages established communities such as Jumeirah Islands and Jumeirah Park.

projects.name: Palm Jebel Ali
projects.blurb: The next palm, a large man-made island off the Jebel Ali coast with beaches, marinas and a mix of villas and apartments.

projects.name: Dubai Islands
projects.blurb: An archipelago of five islands off Deira, with beaches, marinas and a mix of residential and hospitality districts.

projects.name: Como Residences
projects.blurb: A branded residential tower on Palm Jumeirah, with wellness and hospitality design from the Como group.

projects.name: Palm Beach Towers
projects.blurb: A long-established beachfront group on the Palm, with a mall, beach club access and sea-facing apartments.

projects.name: Jumeirah Islands
projects.blurb: A gated villa community on landscaped lake islands, one of Dubai's earlier planned waterfront neighbourhoods.

projects.name: Jumeirah Park
projects.blurb: A family villa community near Dubai Marina and Sheikh Zayed Road, with parks and a community centre.

name: Aldar
tagline: Abu Dhabi's largest developer, now in Dubai too.
about: Aldar is Abu Dhabi's biggest master developer, behind communities on Saadiyat, Yas and Fahid islands, and has also launched in Dubai. For buyers who want the capital rather than the coast of Dubai, it is the reference point.

projects.name: Saadiyat Lagoons
projects.blurb: A family-oriented lagoon community on Saadiyat, with villas and townhouses near the island's beaches and cultural district.

projects.name: Saadiyat Grove
projects.blurb: A mixed-use district on Saadiyat, set among the island's cultural institutions and designed for a walkable day-to-day.

projects.name: Yas Acres
projects.blurb: A leafy villa community on Yas Island, with parks, a golf course and close proximity to theme-park leisure.

projects.name: Yas Bay
projects.blurb: A waterfront entertainment and residential district on Yas Island, with promenade, dining and marina-side living.

projects.name: Fahid Island
projects.blurb: A large new island masterplan between Yas and Saadiyat, planned for beaches, residential neighbourhoods and leisure.

projects.name: Jubail Island
projects.blurb: A mangrove-fringed island community in Abu Dhabi, with villas and apartments planned around nature trails.

projects.name: Haven by Aldar
projects.blurb: Aldar's Dubai launch, a villa and townhouse community in Dubailand planned around central parkland.

name: H&H Development
tagline: Branded residences with the world's hotel and luxury names.
about: H&H builds residences tied to luxury names such as Four Seasons and Baccarat, alongside its Eden-branded projects. It is focused on a handful of high-service addresses in Dubai.

projects.name: Eden House Za'abeel
projects.blurb: An Eden-branded residence in Za'abeel, near Dubai's cultural and business centres.

projects.name: Eden Hills Dubai
projects.blurb: An Eden-branded hillside residential community, presented by H&H as part of its signature collection.

projects.name: Baccarat Residences Dubai
projects.blurb: Residences carrying the Baccarat crystal house name, with interiors drawn from the brand's design language.

projects.name: Four Seasons branded residences
projects.blurb: Residences developed with Four Seasons, bringing the hotel group's service standards to a private-ownership format.
